chapter: Chicago and New York with Louis Armstrong, 1925-30
title: The William Morris office and Zutty's lack of interest in money
summary: In California the William Morris office got Zutty movie bits, but he turned down the road; Pat Rodkin got him a thousand dollars when he would have taken $350, and he refused Joe Sullivan and Pee Wee Russell's calls to return East.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: But still she always wanted to record with Zutt y. And she always said Zutt y played for her better than anybody. But like Zutt y said, business is one thing, friendship's another. Louis could make money so .... But everybody wants to make some money. Except Zutt y, Zutt y never did care. He never did care about making big money. That never phased him. He never worried about it. He was signed up with the William Morris office out in California and they were really looking out for Zutt y. Getting him in movies little parts you know and everything and Zutt y wouldn't let them call him on it. And after he couldn't do any, they couldn't get anything else for him in California they wanted to send him East. Wanted to send him on the road.
Joe Sullivan and Peewee Russell wanted me to come back to New York.
And he said he didn't want to leave California.
Well I loved California so much that I turned them down.

And he was taking gigs by himself. But Pat Rodkin who was his manager, he still loved Zuttie you know. And he told me, Marge, can't you talk to him? Can't you do something with him? I say, now you know he won't leave California.

So, they called Zuttie for a picture and Zuttie accepted it for three hundred and some dollars, some decent or something. And Pat called to find out, he had heard that Zuttie was, they were going to get Zuttie in this band. And he said, Marge what are they going to pay him? I said three hundred and fifty something. He said, is he crazy? He said, well I'm going to take it on myself. I'm going to handle that. He got about a thousand dollars for Zuttie.
Well you know, if you're not experienced with dealing with those........
This was one of the small groups
that William Morris was handling at that time. Because they sent me up to, what's that place in California? Oh God!
Yes but I mean who were you playing with then?
I was playing with a piano player. See, some piano player was playing with me. Riverside. Riverside.
Oh yes, yes. I remember the Riverside.
